HCS LINUX THIRD-PARTY NOTICES
=============================
This file lists open source components, upstream libraries, and AI model weights
used in HCS Linux distributions, along with their respective licensing terms.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Component: llama.cpp
Version:   b3840
Upstream:  https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp.git
License:   MIT
Notes:     CPU-first compilation profile targeting x86_64 AVX/AVX2.

------------------------------------------------------------

Component: niri
Version:   0.1.10
Upstream:  https://github.com/niri-wm/niri.git
License:   GPL-3.0-or-later
Notes:     Scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor.

------------------------------------------------------------

Component: quickshell
Version:   0.2.0
Upstream:  https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell.git
License:   LGPL-3.0-or-later
Notes:     QtQuick-based Wayland desktop shell framework.

------------------------------------------------------------

Component: calamares
Version:   3.3.14
Upstream:  https://packages.debian.org/trixie/calamares
License:   GPL-3.0-or-later
Notes:     System installer customized for HCS branding and profile selection.

------------------------------------------------------------

Component: prime-agent
Version:   0.2.1
Upstream:  https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.git
License:   Apache-2.0
Notes:     Integrated below HCS Brain for autonomous multi-step reasoning.

------------------------------------------------------------

Upstream:  https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/specification.git
License:   MIT
Notes:     Native Rust JSON-RPC stdio implementation for filesystem, bash sandboxing, system telemetry, and memory.
